checks.name: single copy stays acknowledged for two seconds
a later copy receives its own full two-second acknowledgment
a burst of copies owns one pending feedback deadline
unmount leaves no pending feedback callback
a keyed route replacement disposes the old feedback deadline
copy can start fresh after the previous acknowledgment expires
every copy keeps the current map URL and clipboard call count
Strict Mode also releases feedback work when the page leaves
